::: content-section
## About Me

Hello! I'm Yuchi Liu, a Master's student in Biostatistics at **Emory University**. I'm passionate about leveraging statistical methods and machine learning to solve real-world health challenges and drive data-informed decision-making.

My research interests span **AI in healthcare**, **clinical trials**, and **public health data analysis**. I enjoy working at the intersection of statistics, programming, and domain expertise to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets.
:::

::: content-section

::: highlights-grid

Developing and applying statistical models using R, SAS, and Python to analyze biomedical and public health data.
:::

::: highlight-item

### Machine Learning

Building predictive models and evaluating AI systems for healthcare applications, including medical triage and diagnostic support.
:::

### Research

Contributing to cutting-edge research in AI-based medical systems and population health analytics.
